name: Shy Grasshopper 99
author: AnshKaushal
description: Dark black button that scales up on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, background-color changes from #101014 to #f5f0f0, text color changes from #f5f0f0 to #101014, transform becomes scale(1.2).
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Shy Grasshopper 99</title>
<style>
/* Shy Grasshopper 99 by AnshKaushal — https://uiverse.io/AnshKaushal/shy-grasshopper-99 */
button {
  border: 1.5px solid black;
  padding: 10px;
  width: 100px;
  margin: 15px;
  color: #f5f0f0;
  background-color: #101014;
  box-shadow: 3px 3px 6px #101014;
  transition: transform 0.3s ease-in-out;
}

button:hover {
  background-color: #f5f0f0;
  color: #101014;
  transform: scale(1.2);
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button>
  Button
</button>

</body>
</html>
